atAGlance: Gà nướng lá chanh is grilled chicken with lime leaf, usually with charred skin, citrusy lá chanh, and dipping salt.
whatItIs: Gà nướng lá chanh is grilled chicken scented with lime leaves, usually served with herbs and lime-pepper salt. The leaf gives a bright citrus aroma.
howToEnjoy: Eat the grilled chicken with herbs and a light dip of lime-pepper salt. Too much dip can cover the lime-leaf fragrance.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà nướng lá chanh when you want fragrant grilled chicken. Ask for less chili, extra herbs, or dipping salt on the side.
worthKnowing: Lá chanh, lime leaf, is a key Vietnamese chicken aroma; it makes the dish smell fresh before you even bite.
goodToKnow: Ask for no chili if you want Gà nướng lá chanh mild.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà nướng lá chanh.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of grilled chicken with lime leaves.
